strategies.brief: Industry + business news sweep for NEWLY ANNOUNCED Saudi Arabia oil pipeline projects (roughly the last 3 years): "<country> new oil pipeline <year>", FID announcements, MOUs, FEED/EPC awards, tenders, capacity-expansion projects that include new pipe. Search in-country languages too.

Regulator / ministry / TSO paper trail for Saudi Arabia: national energy regulator filings and project inventories, environmental-permit applications, ministry project lists, TSO ten-year development plans (or the national equivalent - FERC-style dockets where they exist).
Operator/sponsor project pages: identify the main midstream, TSO, and NOC players operating in Saudi Arabia and crawl their project/infrastructure pages and annual reports for oil pipeline projects.

The MISSING-pipeline stance: Saudi Arabia national oil grid maps, TSO network maps, oil/energy master plans, IEA/EIA and national-statistics infrastructure inventories - OPERATING or under-construction transmission lines that GEM never captured (not just new announcements). A line on the national grid map with no roster match is exactly what this strategy exists to find.

Cross-border lines touching Saudi Arabia in either direction: interconnectors, import/export lines, transit corridors. Check the neighbouring countries' TSO/ministry project lists for lines that terminate in Saudi Arabia.

Known 2026 leads to run down (verify independently; press URLs checked 2026-07-17 but you must still url_verifier them and corroborate): (1) Reported Saudi Aramco East-West (Petroline) expansion of +1-2 Mbpd, possibly via a parallel products line (pgjonline.com/news/2026/july/saudi-arabia-weighs-2-mmbpd-expansion-of-east-west-oil-pipeline; kpler.com/blog/new-pipelines-bypassing-the-strait-of-hormuz-could-come-online-in-1-2-years) - NO official Aramco announcement as of mid-July 2026 (Aramco declined comment), so apply the add-threshold strictly: this may be class=monitor, not new_row. Existing rows P0551/P2017 are the current East-West system - do NOT duplicate them. (2) Any revival of the shelved Saudi-Omani Oil Pipeline (existing row P5155) - status change evidence goes to notes, not a new row.
